title: Crystals
subtitle: Ritual, intention, and safety
summary: Crystals are used as symbolic supports aligned to chakra themes. Safety guidance keeps elixirs and sunlight use responsible.

sections.title: Chakra correspondences
sections.body: Match stone color and tone to the chakra you want to support.
bullets: Root: Red Jasper, Black Tourmaline, Smoky Quartz
Heart: Rose Quartz, Malachite, Green Aventurine

sections.title: Crystal elixirs (safety)
sections.body: Only safe stones go directly in water. Toxic or soluble stones must use the indirect method.
bullets: Direct-safe: clear/rose/smoky quartz, citrine, amethyst, carnelian, red jasper, aventurine
Indirect-only: malachite, lapis lazuli, tiger's eye (raw), turquoise, selenite, fluorite, moonstone/labradorite, galena, cinnabar

sections.title: Sun sensitivity
sections.body: Some stones fade in sunlight; use moonlight or sound cleansing instead.
bullets: Fade in sun: amethyst, rose quartz, citrine, fluorite, aquamarine, kunzite, celestite
Sun safe: clear quartz, carnelian, jasper, black tourmaline, labradorite
